title: Topological extensions of elementary measurable spaces
summary: An elementary space is a pair $(X, \mathcal A)$, where $\mathcal A$ is an algebra of subsets of $X$. Every elementary space $(X, \mathcal A)$ is naturally a topological space when equipped with the topology $τ_{\mathcal A}$ generated by $\mathcal A$. Elementary mappings on elementary spaces are defined in a manner analogous to measurable mappings on measurable spaces. In addition, the notion of an {\it extension} of an elementary space is introduced. Let $M(X, \mathcal A)$, denote the ring of all real-valued elementary functions on $(X, \mathcal A)$.
